name: evertold
description: Open-source, AI-powered family oral history preservation.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,api,transcription "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:transcription"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @evertold/web && npm run build -w @evertold/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @evertold/web && npm run typecheck -w @evertold/api && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
